priority: P1 — enforce the owner's 20–30 Main Deck and 5-card Extra Deck limits at the actual classic-owned 2v2 lobby acceptance boundary, with atomic rollback.

implementation.behavior: A real classic-owned TagDuel lobby rejects an active 19-card Main Deck, a 31-card Main Deck and a 6-card Extra Deck. Each failed consent must roll back tag_members, lobby revision, automatic deck deactivation and all player/collection/grant/deck writes. After repairing to exact valid boundaries (20, 30 and 5), all four members accept and the TagDuel starts with each physical seat's own UIDs and deck contents.
implementation.validation: Temporary SQLite; active deck creation; isolated player_cards/deck_cards fixture rows; createTagLobby/acceptTag/getTag; deck validation and atomic rollback; TagDuel inventory/physical-seat ownership; Discord public/private payload validation.

limitations: Extra non-starter cards are inserted only as fixture rows in a temporary SQLite database to construct the 31-card and 6-Extra invalid cases; no live player or production collection is accessed.
The test validates the lobby/deck acceptance boundary and Discord payload builders offline; it does not connect to a live Discord guild.
No new card effect is implemented or certified.
